papers.title: Microstructure of γ-titanium aluminide processed by selective laser melting at elevated temperatures
papers.first_author_affiliation: German Aerospace Center, Institute of Materials Research, Linder Hoehe, 51147, Cologne, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Joachim Gussone
corresponding_authors.affiliation: German Aerospace Center, Institute of Materials Research, Linder Hoehe, 51147, Cologne, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究γ-TiAl合金的选区激光熔化显微组织，完全没有涉及生物医学植入物或应力屏蔽问题
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no mechanical testing for biomedical applications

summary_zh.motivation: 研究γ-TiAl合金SLM加工时的微观结构演变
summary_zh.method: 通过控制SLM过程中的基板温度来观察显微组织变化
summary_zh.result: 发现高温下形成细小均匀的γ相组织
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM和XRD分析验证微观结构特征

summary_en.motivation: This paper investigates the microstructure evolution of γ-TiAl alloy during selective laser melting at elevated substrate temperatures.
summary_en.method: The study varied substrate temperature during SLM and characterized resulting microstructures using SEM and XRD.
summary_en.result: Elevated temperatures promoted the formation of fine and homogeneous γ-phase microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization via electron microscopy and X-ray diffraction confirmed phase composition and grain morphology.

papers.title: The Influence of Hip Rotation on Femoral Offset Following Short Stem Total Hip Arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic and Trauma Surgery, University Hospital of Cologne, Cologne, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Christoph Kolja Boese
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic and Trauma Surgery, University Hospital of Cologne, Cologne, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于髋关节旋转对短柄全髋置换术后股骨偏距的影响，属于临床影像学研究，未涉及生物力学建模或应力分析。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanical modeling, no stress/strain/micromotion quantification, no FEA, no comparison of intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究髋关节旋转对短柄全髋置换术后股骨偏距测量的影响
summary_zh.method: 在不同旋转角度下通过X线片测量股骨偏距
summary_zh.result: 髋关节旋转显著改变股骨偏距测量值，需标准化旋转角度
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床患者X线片数据的统计比较

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how hip rotation affects the measurement of femoral offset following short stem total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Radiographic measurement of femoral offset under controlled hip rotation angles in a cohort of patients.
summary_en.result: Hip rotation significantly influences femoral offset values, emphasizing the need for standardized rotation in postoperative assessment.
summary_en.validation: Clinical radiographic study with statistical analysis of repeated measurements.

papers.title: Teriparatide Versus Alendronate for the Preservation of Bone Mineral Density After Total Hip Arthroplasty – A randomized Controlled Trial
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Yokohama City University, 3-9 Fukuura, Kanazawa-ku, Yokohama, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Naomi Kobayashi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Yokohama City University, 3-9 Fukuura, Kanazawa-ku, Yokohama, Japan

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究药物对全髋关节置换术后骨密度的保护作用，不涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical trial of pharmacological intervention (teriparatide vs alendronate) and does not include any biomechanical modeling, finite element analysis, stress shielding quantification, or implant design evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较特立帕肽和阿仑膦酸钠对全髋关节置换术后骨密度的保护效果。
summary_zh.method: 随机对照试验，测量术后不同时间点的骨密度变化。
summary_zh.result: 特立帕肽在部分区域骨密度保留优于阿仑膦酸钠。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随机对照试验，双能X线吸收测定法测量骨密度。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the efficacy of teriparatide versus alendronate in preserving periprosthetic bone mineral density after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A randomized controlled trial measuring bone mineral density changes at multiple postoperative time points using dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry.
summary_en.result: Teriparatide showed superior preservation of bone mineral density in certain Gruen zones compared to alendronate.
summary_en.validation: Clinical randomized controlled trial with DXA-based bone mineral density measurements.

papers.title: Postural and Chronological Change in Pelvic Tilt Five Years After Total Hip Arthroplasty in Patients With Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip: A Three-Dimensional Analysis
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Yokohama City University, 3-9 Fukuura, Kanazawa-ku, Yokohama, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Yutaka Inaba
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Yokohama City University, 3-9 Fukuura, Kanazawa-ku, Yokohama, Japan

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究全髋关节置换术后骨盆倾斜的姿势性和时间性变化，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡、微动或接触力学建模。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses on pelvic tilt changes without any biomechanical modeling or implant design analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究DDH患者THA术后骨盆倾斜的姿势性和时间性变化。
summary_zh.method: 对患者进行术后5年内的三维影像分析，测量不同姿势下的骨盆倾斜角度。
summary_zh.result: 骨盆倾斜在术后早期有显著变化，但随时间趋于稳定。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床影像数据的纵向分析。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate postural and chronological changes in pelvic tilt after total hip arthroplasty in patients with developmental dysplasia of the hip.
summary_en.method: Three-dimensional radiographic analysis was performed on patients at multiple time points up to five years postoperatively, measuring pelvic tilt in various postures.
summary_en.result: Pelvic tilt showed significant changes in the early postoperative period but stabilized over time.
summary_en.validation: Clinical longitudinal study with repeated radiographic measurements.

key_terms.zh: 发育性髋关节发育不良

papers.title: Factors Associated With Early Improvement in Low Back Pain After Total Hip Arthroplasty: A Multi-Center Prospective Cohort Analyses
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, University of Rochester, Rochester, New York

corresponding_authors.name: Peter C. Chimenti
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, University of Rochester, Rochester, New York

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究全髋关节置换术后下背痛的早期改善因素，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或生物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on clinical outcomes of low back pain after THA, with no biomechanical modeling, implant design, or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究全髋关节置换术后下背痛早期改善的相关因素
summary_zh.method: 多中心前瞻性队列分析，收集患者术前术后数据
summary_zh.result: 发现术前疼痛程度和功能状态与术后改善显著相关

summary_en.motivation: To identify factors associated with early improvement in low back pain after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Multi-center prospective cohort study analyzing patient-reported outcomes and clinical variables.
summary_en.result: Preoperative pain severity and functional status were significant predictors of early improvement.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation using multi-center prospective data.

papers.title: Total Hip Arthroplasty after Previous Acetabular Osteotomy: Comparison of Three Types of Acetabular Osteotomy
papers.first_author_affiliation: Funabashi Orthopedic Hospital, Joint Reconstruction Center, Funabashi, Chiba 274-0822 Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Tatsuya Tamaki
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Funabashi Orthopedic Hospital, Joint Reconstruction Center, Funabashi, Chiba 274-0822 Japan

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注髋臼截骨术后全髋置换的临床结果，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或生物力学建模。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical comparison of THA after acetabular osteotomy, with no biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding analysis, no micromotion, and no FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较不同髋臼截骨术后全髋置换的临床效果
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析三种截骨术后THA的并发症和功能评分
summary_zh.result: 不同截骨方式对THA结果有影响，但差异不显著

summary_en.motivation: To compare clinical outcomes of total hip arthroplasty following three types of acetabular osteotomy.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of complications and functional scores in THA patients with prior acetabular osteotomy.
summary_en.result: Different osteotomy types showed some influence on THA outcomes, but differences were not statistically significant.

papers.title: Posterior Mini-Incision With Primary Total Hip Arthroplasty: A Nine to Ten Year Follow Up Study
papers.first_author_affiliation: Keck Medical Center of USC, Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Los Angeles, California

corresponding_authors.name: Yohei Yukizawa
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Keck Medical Center of USC, Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Los Angeles, California

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床随访研究，未涉及任何生物力学建模或应力遮挡分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper reports clinical outcomes of a surgical approach, with no biomechanical modeling, no stress/strain quantification, no micromotion analysis, and no implant design or FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估后路小切口全髋关节置换术的长期临床结果。
summary_zh.method: 对一组患者进行9-10年随访，收集临床评分和影像学数据。
summary_zh.result: 该手术入路在长期随访中显示出良好的临床效果和假体存活率。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the long-term clinical outcomes of posterior mini-incision total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A cohort of patients was followed for 9-10 years with clinical scores and radiographic assessments.
summary_en.result: The posterior mini-incision approach demonstrated favorable clinical outcomes and implant survivorship at long-term follow-up.

papers.title: The Choice Between Total Hip Arthroplasty and Arthrodesis in Adolescent Patients: A Survey of Orthopedic Surgeons

corresponding_authors.name: David M. Studdert
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Stanford Law School, Stanford, California; Center for Health Policy/PCOR, Stanford University School of Medicine, Stanford, California

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注青少年患者全髋关节置换术与关节融合术的选择，不涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical survey on surgical decision-making, with no biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding analysis, no micromotion quantification, and no FEA or implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 调查骨科医生对青少年患者选择全髋关节置换术或关节融合术的偏好。
summary_zh.method: 对骨科医生进行问卷调查，分析手术选择的影响因素。
summary_zh.result: 医生偏好因患者年龄和活动水平而异，但缺乏共识。
summary_zh.validation: 无验证，仅为调查结果统计。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate orthopedic surgeons' preferences for total hip arthroplasty versus arthrodesis in adolescent patients.
summary_en.method: A survey was conducted among orthopedic surgeons to analyze factors influencing surgical choice.
summary_en.result: Surgeon preferences varied with patient age and activity level, but no consensus was found.
summary_en.validation: No validation; only statistical analysis of survey responses.
